steps.title: Design gRNA‑HDR template
steps.instruction: Choose a guide RNA (gRNA) for the target gene using EuPaGDT, retrieve 500 bp upstream and downstream of the gene from PlasmoDB, and design homology regions (HR1 and HR2) of 100 bp according to knockout or tagging strategy. Assemble the synthetic fragment in the order BbsI‑gRNA‑gRNA‑scaffold‑HR2‑AvrII‑HR1‑PstI, verify absence of BbsI, PstI, or AvrII sites, and order the fragment (in pUC‑GW‑Kan) from Genewiz‑Azenta.

steps.title: Prepare pUC‑GW‑Kan vector
steps.instruction: Resuspend lyophilised synthetic fragment in water to 0.1 µg/µL, dilute 1 µL into 99 µL water, transform 1 µL of this dilution into XL10‑Gold competent cells, recover 500 µL warm LB broth for 1 h at 37 °C, 225 rpm, plate 100 µL on LB agar + kanamycin, incubate overnight at 37 °C. Pick a single colony into 4 mL LB + kanamycin, grow ~16 h at 37 °C, 225 rpm, miniprep plasmid DNA, optionally make a 50 % glycerol stock (mix 1 mL culture with 1 mL 50 % glycerol) and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Digest pUC‑GW‑Kan to release insert
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube add 1 µg plasmid, 0.5 µL BbsI, 0.5 µL PstI, 5 µL SmartCut buffer, water to 50 µL; incubate overnight at 37 °C. Add 10 µL 6× loading dye, run on 1 % agarose gel, excise the 320 bp gRNA‑HDR band, purify with NucleoSpin Gel & PCR Clean‑up, elute in 15 µL water, measure concentration (Nanodrop).

steps.title: Digest PbHiT vector with BsmBI
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube add 4 µg PbHiT plasmid, 2 µL BsmBI, 5 µL SmartCut buffer, water to 50 µL; incubate overnight at 55 °C. Next day run 1 µL on 0.7 % agarose gel to confirm linearisation, then purify the linearised vector with NucleoSpin Gel & PCR Clean‑up, eluting twice into 30 µL warm (56 °C) buffer or water. Measure concentration (Nanodrop).

steps.title: Digest PbHiT vector with PstI
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube add the BsmBI‑linearised vector from step 4, add PstI (volume adjusted to plasmid concentration), 5 µL SmartCut buffer, water to 50 µL; incubate overnight at 37 °C. Purify as above (double elution into 30 µL), measure concentration (Nanodrop).

steps.title: Ligate insert into linearised vector
steps.instruction: Calculate insert amount for a 3:1 insert:vector ratio using 50 ng vector (NEBio Calculator). Set up ligation in 10 µL: 50 ng vector, calculated ng insert, 1 µL T4 DNA ligase buffer, 1 µL T4 DNA ligase, water to 10 µL. Incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Transform ligation and confirm colonies
steps.instruction: Transform 2 µL ligation into chemically competent XL10‑Gold cells (ice 30 min, heat shock 30 s at 42 °C, ice 2 min), recover 500 µL warm LB broth 1 h at 37 °C, 225 rpm, plate 100 µL on LB agar + ampicillin, incubate overnight at 37 °C. Perform colony PCR using PbU6prom_F and hsp70UTR_R (25 µL 2× GoTaq, 1 µL each primer, water to 50 µL, 12.5 µL per reaction). PCR program: 95 °C 2 min; 30 × (95 °C 15 s, 50 °C 30 s, 62 °C 1 min); 62 °C 5 min. Run 5 µL on 1 % agarose; a ~600 bp band indicates correct ligation. Grow positive colonies in LB + ampicillin overnight (37 °C, 225 rpm), miniprep plasmid, send for Sanger sequencing, and optionally make glycerol stock (mix 1 mL culture with 1 mL 50 % glycerol, store –80 °C).

steps.title: Linearise final vector with AvrII
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube add 2 µg confirmed PbHiT‑gRNA‑HDR plasmid, 1 µL AvrII, 5 µL SmartCut buffer, water to 50 µL; incubate overnight at 37 °C. Add 10 µL loading dye, run whole digest on 0.7 % agarose gel, excise linearised vector, purify with double elution (30 µL warm buffer). Precipitate DNA: add 0.1 vol sodium acetate, 2.5 vol ice‑cold 100 % ethanol, incubate –20 °C overnight. Centrifuge 16,000 × g 20 min at 4 °C, wash pellet twice with 500 µL 70 % ice‑cold ethanol, air‑dry ~5 min, resuspend in 8 µL Milli‑Q water, verify on 0.7 % agarose gel. Store at 4 °C (short term) or –20 °C (long term).

steps.title: Infect mouse with Cas9 parasites
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen P. berghei ANKA Cas9‑expressing stock, keep on ice in a benchtop cooler, inject 200 µL intraperitoneally into a 6‑week‑old female BALB/c mouse. After ~4 days, when parasitaemia reaches 3‑5 %, proceed to schizont culture.

steps.title: Set up schizont culture
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 mL complete culture medium (RPMI‑1640 72 %, 12.5 mL FBS 25 %, 1 mL 1.2 M sodium bicarbonate for 24 mM, 500 µL penicillin‑streptomycin 1 %, bring to 50 mL with RPMI). Anesthetise mouse with terminal anaesthetic (ketamine 33 % 2 mL + xylazine 16.7 % 1 mL + PBS 3 mL, dose 225‑270 mg/kg ketamine, 47‑60 mg/kg xylazine), collect ~1 mL blood by cardiac puncture, add blood to flask containing medium and gas mixture (3 % CO₂, 1 % O₂, 96 % N₂). Incubate 22 h at 37 °C, 80 rpm shaking.

steps.title: Purify late‑stage schizonts
steps.instruction: Prepare 15.2 % Histodenz/PBS working solution: mix 2.75 mL Histodenz stock (27.6 % w/v) with 2.25 mL 1× PBS (total 5 mL). Transfer culture to 50 mL tube, centrifuge 300 × g 14 min (accel/decel = 1) at room temperature, discard supernatant leaving ~3 mL, resuspend pellet, layer gently onto Histodenz gradient. Centrifuge 300 × g 20 min (accel/decel = 1). Collect the brown middle layer (schizonts), transfer to new 15 mL Falcon tube, wash with room‑temperature RPMI up to 15 mL, centrifuge 450 × g 3 min (accel/decel = 3), discard supernatant. Keep pellet on ice (minimum 2 µL needed per transfection).

steps.title: Electroporate schizonts with vector
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm heat box to 37 °C and place mice inside. Fill one insulin syringe per transfection with 100 µL room‑temperature RPMI, label. Resuspend schizont pellet in P3 buffer (minimum 2 µL pellet per transfection; for one transfection use 18 µL P3). Mix 20 µL schizont‑P3 suspension with 7 µL linearised vector (from step 6), resuspend, transfer 26 µL into one well of a 16‑well Nucleocuvette strip (avoid bubbles). Electroporate using Lonza 4D‑Nucleofector, program FI 115, solution P3. Immediately add the 100 µL RPMI from the syringe to the cuvette well, gently aspirate all contents, remove bubbles, and inject the mixture intravenously into the lateral caudal vein of the mouse. Provide pyrimethamine‑treated drinking water (0.07 mg/mL in tap water, protected from light) to the mouse the next day.

steps.title: Monitor parasitaemia and collect blood
steps.instruction: From day 3 post‑transfection, daily tail‑bleed: prick tail with lancet, place drop on glass slide, fix 30 s in 100 % methanol, stain 10 min in 10 % Giemsa, add oil, examine under 100× light microscope. When parasitaemia reaches ~3 %, euthanise mouse (cardiac puncture) and collect ~1 mL blood. Use 20 µL of blood for genomic DNA extraction (see step 15) and mix remaining blood 1:1 with parasite freezing solution (5 mL 100 % glycerol + 45 mL Alsever’s solution, filter‑sterilised) for storage at –80 °C (or –120 °C).

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA from blood
steps.instruction: Resuspend 20 µL infected blood in 180 µL PBS, perform DNeasy Blood & Tissue kit protocol, elute twice in 100 µL ultra‑pure water. Store gDNA at 4 °C or –20 °C.

steps.title: Genotype integration by PCR
steps.instruction: Design gene‑specific upstream (UPS_F) and downstream (DWS_R) primers flanking HR1 and HR2. Use communal primers hsp70UTR_R (for 5′ integration) and PbU6prom_F (for 3′ integration). Set up 50 µL PCRs with 2× GoTaq or DreamTaq (0.5 µL polymerase, 1 µL each primer, 2.5 µL buffer, 0.5 µL dNTPs, water to 25 µL, add 10 ng gDNA). For GoTaq anneal 2 °C below Tm; for DreamTaq anneal 5 °C below Tm; extension at 62 °C. Include wild‑type gDNA control. Run products on 1 % agarose gel; 5′ integration yields ~600 bp, 3′ integration also ~600 bp, wild‑type band ~7 kb (not amplified under these conditions).

steps.title: Remove drug cassette with 5‑FC (optional)
steps.instruction: If desired, treat parasites with 5‑fluorocytosine to select for loss of hdhfr/yfcu cassette. Infect a mouse from the mutant stock, monitor parasitaemia, and when >0.1 % give 5‑FC in drinking water (1 mg/mL in tap water, protected from light). After 3‑5 % parasitaemia post‑5‑FC, collect blood, extract gDNA, and confirm loss of cassette and absence of wild‑type locus by PCR as in step 12.

steps.title: Scale‑up pooled ligation (optional)
steps.instruction: Purify plasmid from a single colony per vector (step 3) or from glycerol stocks. Pool 12 vectors to total 2 µg DNA, digest with 1 µL BbsI, 1 µL PstI, 5 µL SmartCut buffer, water to 50 µL; incubate 37 °C overnight. Run whole digest on 1 % agarose, excise pooled insert, purify as in step 2. Ligate pooled insert into linearised PbHiT vector exactly as in step 5, transform 2 µL ligation, plate on LB + ampicillin, incubate overnight. Either pick individual colonies for separate vectors (step 8) or pool all colonies, grow in 500 mL LB + ampicillin, purify plasmid with Midi kit. Confirm ligation by Sanger (individual) or NGS (pooled).

steps.title: Pooled vector transfection and sampling (optional)
steps.instruction: Grow each pUC‑GW‑Kan vector (from glycerol stock) in 1 mL LB + kanamycin (50 µg/mL) in a 96‑deep‑well plate, overnight 37 °C, 225 rpm. Pool cultures in groups of 12, purify plasmids, perform pooled ligation (step 13), and purify final ligated vectors with Midi kit. For a 12‑vector pool, combine ~450 ng of each vector (≈5.4 µg total). Linearise pool with AvrII (0.5 µL enzyme per µg DNA, 30 µL SmartCut buffer, water to 300 µL), incubate 37 °C overnight, purify, resuspend in 30 µL water, verify on 0.7 % agarose gel. Infect a mouse with 200 µL frozen Cas9 parasite stock, after 3‑4 days infect a rat with mouse blood (recommended for large pools). Set up a 200 mL schizont culture as in step 7. Transfect pooled vector into schizonts following step 8, dividing DNA/schizont/P3 mixture among three 16‑well Nucleocuvette strips. After electroporation, collect all samples into a 1.5 mL tube, resuspend in 300 µL RPMI, split into three insulin syringes, inject each mouse intravenously. Provide pyrimethamine‑treated water day 1 post‑transfection. Collect an input sample immediately after electroporation by washing cuvettes with 200 µL PBS, boil 95 °C 5 min, centrifuge 16,200 × g, store supernatant at –20 °C. From day 4‑8, collect 20 µL tail‑bleed blood into a heparin‑preloaded tip, add to 200 µL PBS + 10 µL heparin, keep at 4 °C until final collection.

steps.title: Prepare NGS libraries (optional)
steps.instruction: Extract gDNA from each time‑point sample (as step 11). Set up PCR1 to amplify the barcode region using primers BC_pHiT_illumina_F and BC_pHiT_illumina_R (PAGE‑purified). For each 25 µL reaction: 0.5 µL polymerase, 0.5 µL forward primer, 0.5 µL reverse primer, 2.5 µL buffer, 0.5 µL dNTPs, 15.5 µL water, 5 µL gDNA. Cycle: 95 °C 5 min; 35 × (95 °C 30 s, 55 °C 20 s, 68 °C 8 s); 68 °C 10 min. Verify 250 bp product on 1 % agarose. PCR2 adds Illumina adapters: master mix same as PCR1 but only generic PE 1.0 primer in mix; add 1 µL index primer per well, 5 µL PCR1 product, water to 50 µL. Cycle: 95 °C 2 min; 10 × (95 °C 30 s, 68 °C 15 s); 68 °C 5 min. Verify on agarose. Purify all PCR2 products with MinElute 96 UF kit: bind, wash twice with 50 µL ultra‑pure water, elute with 30 µL water. Measure each sample with Qubit dsDNA HS assay, pool 125 ng of each sample. Send pooled library for Illumina sequencing (MiSeq: dilute to 1.5 pM, load at 4 × 10⁵ clusters/mm²; NextSeq: SPRI‑select 1:0.8 cleanup, dilute to 0.5 pM, load at 7 × 10⁴ clusters/mm²).

steps.title: Analyze CRISPR screen data (optional)
steps.instruction: Use the provided R pipeline (https://github.com/henriksson‑lab/pbhit_analyzer) to extract gRNA counts, normalize to dispensable‑gene controls, fit logistic growth curves (carrying capacity = 1) with minpack.lm, compute relative growth rates per gene, remove failed fits, and visualise results (RShiny, ggplot2, plotROC).

description: Validation of protocol This protocol (or parts of it) has been used and validated in the following research article(s): • Jonsdottir et al. [26]. A scalable CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing system facilitates CRISPR screens in the malaria parasite Plasmodium berghei . Nucleic Acids Research (Figures 3–5 and Supplemental Figures S3 and S5–S11).
